integrity: The proof exhausts primes, prime squares, and squarefree semiprimes. Elementary parity and residue-class prime-counting bounds reduce the only surviving semiprime branch to the exact finite range \(q\le61\), which is supplied as a complete certificate. The large finite sweep is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only \(n>1\) with \(\Omega(n)\le2\). It does not classify the later higher-multiplicity members of A067787.
title: Complete \(\Omega(n)\le2\) classification for \(\pi(\sigma(n))=\varphi(n)\)
